theme: Light mode primary with high-contrast Midnight Blue editorial sections (Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Archetype 5: Luxury).

rules: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for all headings above 32px.
Never center-align paragraphs; maintain left-alignment for dense content.
Maximum heading size should be text-6xl for the hero.
Use uppercase with wide tracking (tracking-widest) for overlines and labels.
Do NOT use Inter for main headings. Use Outfit in Black/Bold weights for strong authority.
No full-screen flat gradients. Use subtle noise/grain textures if needed.
Rely on solid color contrasts (White vs. Midnight Blue) to separate sections.
Use Brand Blue strictly for CTAs and interactive highlights.
Never use pure black or pure white; tint slightly (e.g., #FAFAFA, #0A0A0A).

visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for floating elements, but prefer 1px sharp borders for a technical, Swiss-brutalist consulting look.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Subtle roundness (rounded-lg to rounded-xl), avoiding overly pill-shaped containers unless it's a specific button.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) ONLY for sticky headers. Cards should be solid with a 1px border.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 to py-32 for section padding. Containers must have p-6 or p-8 internal padding.
grids_and_layouts.hero_layout: Asymmetric. Large kinetic text dominating 70% of the screen, with overlapping raw imagery or a subtle 3D/parallax element.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: Use for the 'Trust/Why-Us' section. Mix col-span-2 and col-span-1 to create visual tension.
grids_and_layouts.general: Start with grid-cols-1 for mobile, md:grid-cols-12 for desktop layouts. Use gap-8 to gap-12.

motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Kinetic Hero with masked reveal. Wrap each line of the H1 in an overflow-hidden span, and animate the text upward (y: 100% to 0) using framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for the trust line ('Tamil Nadu MSMEs — built for you • No hidden charges • 100% Confidential'). Use react-fast-marquee or framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Hover states on all buttons and cards (-translate-y-1, shadow-lg). Ensure focus states are accessible (ring-2 ring-brand_blue).

components_strategy.marketing_sections: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for Hero, Problem Manifesto, and Trust sections to allow extreme creative layout freedom.
components_strategy.forms_and_interactive: Use shadcn/ui components (Input, Select, Form, Dialog) for the Multi-step 'Free Business Health Scan' form and Contact form. Customize them heavily to remove the default Vercel look (e.g., thicker borders, square corners, or brand blue focus).
components_strategy.tables: Interactive Problems->Solutions table and Services Pricing table should use native HTML tables or CSS grids with clear 1px borders, hover row highlights, and generous padding.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text over images or dark backgrounds meets APCA/WCAG AA standards. Use text-shadow or a gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-black/70 to-transparent) on hero images if needed.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='health-scan-cta').
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all framer-motion animations.

hero_or_trust_retail.description: Smiling Indian retail shop owner, representing the MSME target audience.

consultation_meeting.description: Professionals shaking hands in an office, symbolizing partnership.

dashboard_analytics.description: Laptop showing data analytics, representing the 'Executive Dashboard' and tech implementations.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST use .js and .jsx extensions for all files.
Implement Lenis smooth scroll globally in the App layout.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for the sticky header; use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 or solid white.
For the 'Free Business Health Scan', build a multi-step form utilizing state to progress through 8 conceptual steps.
Use framer-motion for the masked kinetic text reveal on the Hero H1 ('Stop Buying Websites...').
For the editorial marquee, use framer-motion to continuously scroll the trust text slowly.
DO NOT output standard centered generic layouts. Use large typography, heavy grid lines, and high-contrast section backgrounds (e.g., alternate between Stark White and Midnight Blue).
Ensure the 'Problems -> Solutions' interactive table feels premium, perhaps with row-expand or hover-reveal logic.
Incorporate the required 'data-testid' on all interactive elements.
Never use generic placeholder text; stick strictly to the provided copy for GoGreat.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or sharp with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
